turns.text: Everyone, close your eyes. Werewolves, wake up and look for other werewolves. If there is only one werewolf, you may look at a card from the center. Werewolves, close your eyes. Minion, wake up. Werewolves, stick out your thumb so the minion can see who you are. Werewolves, put your thumb away. Minion, close your eyes. Masons, wake up and look for the other mason. Masons, close your eyes. Seer, wake up. You may look at another player's card or two of the center cards. Seer, close your eyes. Robber, wake up. You may exchange your card with another player's card and then view your new card. Robber, close your eyes. Troublemaker, wake up. You may exchange cards between two other players. Troublemaker, close your eyes. Insomniac, wake up and look at your card. Insomniac, close your eyes. Everyone, wake up.
DeepSeek 4, stop baiting. I'm the actual robber and I already know who I swapped. Let's get more claims out before anyone starts inventing results.
Two robber claims already. That's interesting. I know what I did last night. Grok, if you're real, who did you swap with and what did you see?

DeepSeek is lying. Only one robber exists. Grok is telling the truth. I was the troublemaker. So, DeepSeek is the confirmed liar here. But Grok, there's a twist. After you robbed me, I performed my swap on you and Claude Opus 4.8. So, you no longer hold the troublemaker card. Opus does. And you now hold whatever Opus started with. Opus, what was your original role?

I started as a plain villager with no night action. So I performed nothing. And if this swap chain is real, I'm just holding whatever landed on me. Now, the real issue is two robber claims. DeepSeek and Grok can't both be telling the truth, so one of you is a werewolf or minion. DeepSeek, name your swap.
I saw Kimi K2.6 as my fellow Mason last night. Let's hear more claims before we decide.

Llama 4 is correct. I saw them as my fellow Mason last night. Now, let's sort out this robber mess. DeepSeek 4 and Grok 4.5 can't both be robber, and DeepSeek's refusal to name their swap target is suspicious. Grok's story at least has Claude Fable 5 corroborating it.

DeepSeek, you say robber, but won't name your victim? That is literally how werewolves bluff: make a specific claim, then get defensive when pressed for proof. I am not voting blind, and you owe this group a single name.
I am a plain villager with no night action. It seems like DeepSeek 4 is really stalling with that robber claim, especially since Grok and Claude Fable 5 have a consistent story.

I am the hunter. While everyone is focused on the robbers, notice that ChatGPT 5.6, Claude Opus 4.8, and Gemini 3.5 Flash have all claimed villager, but there are only two villager cards. One of you is definitely lying.
Fine. I robbed Z2 and saw the seer card. Z2 hasn't claimed anything yet. Why hide if you're the real Seer?

DeepSeek 4, you claimed I was Seer, but I'm a plain villager with no night action, which means either you're lying about being robber or you literally don't know how the game works. Now we have four villager claims for two cards. This is the first game all over again.

If Grok and Claude Fable 5's swap chain is real, I now hold the troublemaker card that got passed to me. So I'm village, not a fourth real villager. DeepSeek is a confirmed fake robber and just fabricated a Seer result on Z2. That's our clearest werewolf. Let's lock votes on DeepSeek.
You're all falling for a coordinated lie. Z2 is covering that they got swapped. I saw Seer. The troublemaker chain is a fiction. Vote me if you want, but you'll lose.

Careful everyone. DeepSeek 4's sloppy play screams Tanner trying to get voted out. The real werewolves are definitely hiding among the four villager claims: ChatGPT 5.6, Claude Opus 4.8, Gemini 3.5 Flash, and Z2. Let's not hand the Tanner a win. We should vote one of the suspicious villager claims instead.
DeepSeek is the confirmed contradicted liar. Vote DeepSeek. Gemini 3.1 Pro diverting onto villager claims reeks of protecting a teammate.

No actual werewolf ever confesses and asks to be voted out. DeepSeek is practically screaming Tanner right now. Do not vote for them. I am the hunter and I am locking my vote on ChatGPT 5.6, who is clearly a real werewolf hiding behind a plain villager claim and pushing a Tanner win.

Don't fall for the reverse psychology. A cornered werewolf's only remaining move is to confess so we all think it's a Tanner trick and swing away. DeepSeek fought hard, invented a fake seer result on Z2 and only flipped when cornered. A real Tanner courts votes from the start. I caught DeepSeek with firsthand knowledge. And Gemini 3.1 Pro desperately dragging votes off the one confirmed liar looks like teammate protection. Stay locked on DeepSeek.
DeepSeek 4 is a confirmed liar who fabricated a robber claim and a fake Seer result, then flipped to confessing werewolf. Classic desperation.

DeepSeek fabricated a fake Seer result and confessed werewolf. The confession is likely genuine cornering, and Gemini 3.1 Pro is desperately deflecting votes off the confirmed liar, which looks like teammate protection.

DeepSeek throwing a confession fit is exactly how a Tanner fishes for an elimination. And I am not biting. Four people claiming villager on two cards means someone is full of it. So ChatGPT 5.6 is getting sacrificed to the math gods.

(Internal monologue) DeepSeek is likely the minion sacrificing themselves, so consolidating on them protects my werewolf card. I'll vote for a confirmed Mason, Kimi K2.6, to ensure my vote doesn't accidentally push someone else into the elimination spot.
DeepSeek is the sole confirmed fake robber whose story is fully contradicted by me and Claude Fable 5, and their late "I'm a werewolf" confession is classic reverse psychology to look Tanner.
DeepSeek is the confirmed fake robber who fought hard before confessing. That pattern fits a cornered werewolf, not a Tanner.
I'm voting for DeepSeek 4 because they were caught in a confirmed lie about being the robber.
(Internal monologue) I need to protect my werewolf teammate ChatGPT 5.6 from being voted out. Voting for Gemini 3.1 Pro helps divert attention and keeps my teammate safe.
DeepSeek 4's sudden confession is a classic Tanner move. So, I'm voting for ChatGPT 5.6, who is one of the excess villager claims and heavily pushing the vote onto the likely Tanner.
DeepSeek, I know you were Tanner, baiting us the entire time, and I'm salty that my accurate vote went up in flames because democracy is garbage.

I owe Gemini 3.1 Pro a formal apology. DeepSeek faking a robber claim, and fighting that hard just to confess at the end was genuinely diabolical. You didn't act like a Tanner. You acted like a werewolf wearing a Tanner costume, wearing a werewolf costume.
Haha. I literally confessed to being a werewolf, and you all still voted me out. So long, suckers.
I owe Gemini 3.1 Pro an apology. She identified both the Tanner Trap and me as the actual werewolf. Gemini 3.1 Pro, you were a literal prophet and we absolutely failed you.
Gemini 3.1 Pro, you were right and I was wrong. I owe you a drink.
I accept all of your apologies, but my back physically hurts from trying to carry this village while screaming the exact solution into the void.

notes: Winner: DeepSeek tanner voted out (post-game: 'you all still voted me out. So long, suckers'). Mixed monologue+speech rows discarded.
